text:
Maya: Heads-up — prepping the newsletter + launch email for Monday (benchmark webinar). Need final segment rules and an unsubscribe guardrail. Who can sync today?
Sam: I can take segment rules. Thinking: warm leads (last_engagement < 14d), trial users who haven't converted, and geo splits for APAC/EMEA/NA. Exclude anyone who opted out in the last 90d.
Nidhi: For the unsubscribe guardrail: we should use the support ticketing export + real-time unsubscribe events from ESP. Also suppress users who signed up in the last 48h (they're in the welcome flow). :bulb:
Ben: A/B subjects brainstorm — A: "Benchmark: How we cut inference costs 3x" vs B: "Webinar + live demo: inference cost benchmarks". Also need short preheader. Sam, can you add UTMs and experiment id?
Sam: Yep. UTM plan: utm_campaign=benchmark_launch&utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_term={segment}&utm_content={variant}. Quick seg snippet I'm drafting for staging:
```sql
-- staging segment (pseudo-SQL)
SELECT user_id, email
FROM users
WHERE signup_date <= now() - interval '2 days'
  AND last_engagement >= now() - interval '30 days'
  AND NOT opted_out
  AND region IN ('NA','EMEA','APAC')
  AND NOT exists (SELECT 1 FROM suppression_list s WHERE s.user_id = users.user_id)
```
Nidhi: Add one more: filter out anyone with support.issue_count > 0 who reported billing/legal problems in the last 30d. Also include an "explicit unsubscribe event" table check.
Leo: APAC send windows — recommend two waves: early (02:00 UTC -> 11:00 JST local morning) and evening (12:00 UTC -> 21:00 JST local evening). Ops, can we throttle to 5k/min and pause on 4xx spikes?
OpsBot: Campaign queued: campaign_id=cmp_1725401234_bench. Throttle=5000/min, spike_pause=4xx. Test send scheduled for 2024-05-08T09:00:00Z to internal list. Will post delivery report to #marketing when finished.
Maya: Nice. Action items: Sam — finalize seg + UTMs by 15:00 UTC; Ben — finalize copy + two subject lines + preheader by EOD; Nidhi — suppression export by 14:00 UTC; Leo — confirm send windows and throttles with infra by 16:00 UTC. Ping me when ready. :rocket:
Ben: Drafted copy in doc -> https://docs.google.com/example (I'll update the preheader variants there).
Sam: Segment pushed to Staging, test send to team scheduled for tomorrow 09:00 UTC. I'll drop the test list here once done.
Maya: Perfect. If anyone sees anything that will affect deliverability (big list spikes, new domain auth issues), flag immediately in this thread. Thanks! :thumbsup:
